title: Environment
description: Canonical Environment contract per DEVOS-SPEC-023. An Environment holds runtime configuration owned by exactly one Profile. Sensitive values MUST be Secret references, never literals; resolution happens only at usage time through authorized systems.

variables.description: Environment variables as name/value pairs. Values MAY be literals for non-sensitive data or Secret references for sensitive data.

runtimeConfig.description: Key/value configuration entries consumed by tooling.

$comment: An Environment MUST NOT contain literal sensitive values; enforcement of reference-only sensitive values belongs to domain validation per DEVOS-SPEC-023 and custody rules of DEVOS-SPEC-028.
